issues.description: Raw labels are 00:10 through 24:00; no statement specifies interval averages versus point measurements. Main path treats power as preceding-interval averages. Q1 point-linear periodic-boundary sensitivity is provided separately.

All five templates start at 00:10-00:20 and omit same-day 00:00-00:10. result1 ends at 00:00+1-00:10+1; other wide sheets end at ambiguous 00:00-00:10+1. Exact label-preserving export cannot simultaneously certify canonical same-day coverage without a disclosed mapping.
Battery and emergency templates contain example date blocks and ellipses, not all 334 days. Expand output copies while preserving table columns, sheet names and formats.

Forecast columns are hour-ahead values at leads 1..24; there is no lead-0 value. Retain every release separately. Point-to-interval reconstruction must declare its causal lead-0 boundary and retain energy/nonnegative checks.
Attachment 4 gives delivery-slot prices with no publication timestamps. Actual prices must not automatically become known day-ahead prices.

Attachment 1 load and price profiles are numerically very close to annual per-slot averages of Attachments 2 and 4. This is not proof of generation provenance and does not authorize using Attachment 1 load/PV in Q2-4 forecasting or knowing future variable prices.

cross_source_relationships.interpretation: Observed numeric similarity does not prove how the organizer created the inputs. Do not use Attachment 1 load/PV to train Q2-4 or infer that future variable prices are published in advance.
